name: Jayce
notes: Jayce opens already in Cannon Stance: the t=0 R cast (Transform) is read as the initial press that leaves default Hammer Stance for Cannon Stance, arming Cannon's on-attack armor/MR shred.

Transform (R) is then recast every time its flat 6s cooldown is up, toggling stance for the rest of the fight, so both stances' kits (Shock Blast/Hyper Charge/Acceleration Gate in Cannon, To the Skies!/Lightning Field/Thundering Blow in Hammer) get real playtime; a swap is delayed until an active Hyper Charge window finishes so its 3 attacks are not wasted.

The dossier leaves open whether switching stances applies or discards a still-pending Transform empowered attack (Cannon's shred / Hammer's bonus magic damage); this driver discards it unused on a swap, the simpler reading.

Shock Blast is read as landing on cast (its 0.2143 s cast time only drives the usual 0.25 s post-cast attack lockout, not a separate travel delay) and is always assumed to pass through a freshly-placed Acceleration Gate for the 1.4x supercharge, since Jayce stands on his own gate; Acceleration Gate itself deals no damage and is recast on cooldown purely to keep that window up.

Thundering Blow's damage lands 0.25 s after its cast (its stated cast time), and for 0.4 s after that Jayce cannot cast Shock Blast/To the Skies!, modeled as a shared lockout on the Q hook regardless of current stance.

Shock Blast's own flat 8 s cooldown (numbers sheet 'other JayceShockBlast') is used for the Cannon-Stance Q instead of the by-rank array shared with To the Skies! in ddragon; that by-rank array is used for To the Skies! itself. Likewise Acceleration Gate's own flat 16 s cooldown is used instead of the by-rank E array, which is kept for Thundering Blow.

Hyper Charge's empowered-attack window is taken as the bin's 3.6 s (JayceHyperCharge.Duration) rather than the wiki text's rounded 4 s; its total damage is explicitly stated to crit and is applied once per empowered attack landed, and it resets Jayce's attack timer on cast. Its cooldown starts post-effect (when the window/attacks end), matching the sheet.

Lightning Field's total base+AP damage is split evenly across its 4 one-second ticks; the field keeps ticking after a stance swap since it is already active in the world, independent of Jayce's current form.

Jayce is treated as ranged with Cannon Stance's 500 attack range for the entire fight (even during Hammer-Stance windows), since the driver cannot vary attack range mid-fight; this slightly understates Hammer Stance's melee reality but keeps the model simple.

The armor/MR shred and Hammer's bonus on-hit magic damage from Transform scale by champion level; the shred is a single static value read by the engine so it is fixed at the level-16 figure (35%), while the Hammer bonus damage is computed from the actual fight level.

The dossier notes the last Hyper Charge attack is checked on-hit rather than on-attack (so a prior on-hit effect like Runaan's/Guinsoo's could suppress it); this driver applies all 3 empowered instances uniformly and does not model that edge case.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: Cannon Stance's armor/MR shred scales by level (20-35%); the engine reads a single static percent from the kit, so the level-16 figure is used since fights run at level 16.
